_comment: Static symbol artwork for Brain Train, set v4. Two kinds of source: (1) owner-supplied images (Downloads/symbol, generated with Gemini 2.5 Flash Image) on light backgrounds, style "cutout": the background is removed by tool/assets/cutout.py; (2) IconScout premium 3D icons and illustrations downloaded with the owner's IconScout subscription: 3D icons are transparent PNGs (trimmed, centred, normalised); illustrations with a scene background use "cutout" too. Originals live in art/source/symbols-v4/ (gitignored). Process with `python3 tool/assets/prepare_symbols.py`. Each entry has a `status`: "integrated" (WebP written and reviewed; only these go into the registry), "pending" (source present, not yet reviewed), "rejected" (see its `rejected` reason; unreadable at a 31 px tile) or "awaiting download" (IconScout source not downloaded yet; the 3D download quota ran out). Pack items left out as duplicates are not listed.
provider: Owner-supplied (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image) + IconScout (premium 3D icons and illustrations)
licenseNote: Owner-supplied images: supplied by the owner for use in Brain Train. IconScout assets: downloaded under the owner's IconScout subscription license (commercial use, no attribution required); sourceUrl lists each asset page.
